text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Hishi Amazon and Narita Brian fall 
short in the Arima Kinen. Yet, all eyes 
remain fixed on Narita Brian after her 
extraordinary, otherworldly run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Channeling her frustration into fuel, 
Hishi Amazon trained harder than ever. She 
vowed to get her revenge against Narita 
Brian at next year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After discussing it with her Trainer, 
Hishi Amazon set her sights on the Osaka 
Hai as her next goal. Naturally, she was 
aiming for nothing less than first 
place...!
